title: Welcome, Mazinda! A baby rhino in England
lead: A southern white rhino calf was born at Whipsnade Zoo, and his name tells a special story.
body: A baby rhino, or calf, was born at Whipsnade Zoo, north of London, on 1 November 2026. He is a southern white rhino. His mum is called Fahari and his dad is called Sizzle.
The calf weighed about 40 kilos when he was born. The keepers say he is very curious: he already loves exploring his new home next to his mum.
His name is Mazinda, and it's a special name! In 1971, the first southern white rhino born in Europe was a female called Mazinda, and she was born at Whipsnade too.

The zoo started its rhino programme in 1970, with rhinos from South Africa. The new Mazinda is the 61st calf born there. At the end of the 1800s, there were only about 20 southern white rhinos left in the wild. Today, there are about 17,500 in Africa.

options: It's the name of a keeper
It's the name of the first white rhino born in Europe
